headline: Your reviews are in good shape. The old website and online booking are the two spots to fix.

areas.title: Google listing
areas.found: Birdeye’s page for Queenie Nail Salon at 648 Strander Blvd shows 4.4 from 501 Google reviews, checked 4 Oct 2026. The same page lists Tuesday opening at 9:00 AM. The shop card says Monday–Saturday open at 9:30 AM. The other days match the card: 9:30 AM–7:00 PM, and Sunday 10:00 AM–6:00 PM.
areas.why: A guest who follows the listing may show up at 9:00 on a Tuesday. The 4.4 itself is a strong public rating.
areas.fix: If you open at 9:30, set Tuesday on the Google listing to match the card. Add a few current photos when you can.
notChecked: Photo count on the Google listing
Whether the owner replies to reviews

areas.title: Website
areas.found: We opened queeniespanails.com on 4 Oct 2026. It is not the Tukwila salon. The page is an unrelated Indonesian site, last modified 3 Oct 2026. queenie-nail-spa.business.site returns a 404. Birdeye still lists http://queeniespanails.com/ as this shop’s website. A price list for the Tukwila salon is not on that live domain.
areas.why: Someone who taps the website from a listing does not reach Queenie.
areas.fix: Use a one-page site with your name, phone, hours, and a text-us line. A sample preview is already in the box below.
notChecked: Mobile layout of a shop site, because no shop site is there to open

areas.title: Phone and texting
areas.found: Not checked. This row waits for a live call on the visit. We did not call (425) 227-0954 for this report.
areas.why: The front-desk question is simple: if nobody picks up, does a text come back?
areas.fix: Call during open hours and fill in the line below.

areas.title: Online booking
areas.found: No online booking link is stored for this shop, and none turned up for 648 Strander Blvd. Fresha pages for other salons with Queen in the name are in Everett and Queen Anne, not this address.
areas.why: A guest who wants a time still has to get through on the phone.
areas.fix: Add one booking link you control, or a text line that can answer when the phone is busy.

areas.title: Reviews vs nearby
areas.found: These Google counts are the ones Birdeye showed on 4 Oct 2026. Nail Bar & Spa in the directory is the Southcenter door. Public pages call that door TH Nail Bar & Spa, at the same address and the same phone, (206) 397-3959.
areas.why: When the ratings sit this close, a guest often leans toward the shop with more reviews.
areas.fix: Ask happy guests for a Google review when the visit went well. Reply history was not checked.
